citazioni: Mixtures in the ratio of 1:1 and 2:1 of the respective fluoroquinolone and carboxylic acid were ball-milled, and salt formation was confirmed by X-ray powder diffraction (Figures S31–S48).
In the case of cip/az, cip/adi, cip/pim, cip/glu, enro/az, and enro/glu, the patterns of the 2:1 mixtures showed the peaks of the 1:1 salt and free fluoroquinolone.

Bulk samples of the salts for the gelation experiments were prepared by liquid-assisted grinding. Room-temperature milling experiments were performed using an oscillatory ball mill (Mixer Mill MM400, Retsch GmbH & Co., Germany) with a 25 mL stainless steel milling jar containing one 15 mm diameter stainless steel ball. The fluoroquinolone and respective coformer were physically mixed in a 1:1 or 2:1 molar ratio (0.25 g sample total). Twenty-five microliters of methanol was added to the milling jar, and the samples were milled at 25 Hz for up to 60 min with a cool-down period of 15 min after 30 min of milling. The milled powder samples were analyzed immediately by X-ray powder diffraction.

citazioni: Cip, nor, or enro (0.1 mmol) and a molar equivalent of the respective carboxylic acid coformer were dissolved in the minimum amount of solvent (water, methanol, ethanol, acetonitrile, acetonitrile/methanol, acetone, and ethyl acetate). The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature. Details of the crystallization experiments are provided in the Supporting Information (Tables S1–S3).
Several of the salts crystallized as different stoichiomorphs, solvates, or polymorphs depending on the solvent.

citazioni: Two polymorphs of (nor+)2(adi2–)·2H2O were obtained from water and methanol/acetonitrile (1:1), respectively, denoted form I and form II (Figure 7c,d).
The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature.
Two polymorphs of (nor+)2(adi2–)·2H2O were obtained from water and methanol/acetonitrile (1:1), respectively, denoted form I and form II (Figure 7c,d).
The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature.

Cocrystallizing enro with adi from acetonitrile and nor with az from methanol gave two new stoichiomorphs of enro/adi and nor/az that can be classified as conjugate acid/base molecular ionic cocrystals.34
The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature.

Cocrystallizing enro with adi from acetonitrile and nor with az from methanol gave two new stoichiomorphs of enro/adi and nor/az that can be classified as conjugate acid/base molecular ionic cocrystals.34
The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature.
Our cocrystallization screen also yielded two new solvates of enro, namely, enro.CH3CN and enro.H2O (Figure S1).
The solutions were left in open vials to slowly evaporate at room temperature.

citazioni: To prepare a 10% w/v gel, 100 mg of the powdered sample was dissolved in 1 mL of the respective solvent in a standard 15 × 160 mm test tube. Samples were heated to within 10 °C of the respective solvent’s boiling point under stirring until dissolved. Samples were then allowed to cool slowly to room temperature.
The XRPD pattern of the enro/sub/H2O xerogel is a good match with that of the (enro+)(sub–)·H2O single crystal (Figure S52).

note: Sali e cocristalli ionici molecolari di cip, nor, enro con acidi α,ω-dicarbossilici (glu, adi, pim, sub, az, seb). Strutture: 26 sali elencati nei Risultati (13 A+B–, 10 A2+B2–, 2 A2+B2–B, 1 A+B–A) piu' 2 solvati di enro; l'abstract e le conclusioni parlano di «27 new» strutture e i CCDC sono 2128064-2128092 (29 numeri), non attribuiti alle singole forme. Le forme sono create per tutti i sali strutturati anche quando non hanno eventi. Incoerenze dell'articolo: «(cip+)(glu–)... two pim– anions» (sembra un refuso); (enro+)2(adi2–)·adi·2CH3CN contro ·adi·CH3CN; (cip+)2(sub2–)·4H2O e «·H2O» in testo e Fig. 6; «(enro+)(glu–)·0.33H3CN·0.67H2O»; il triidrato (nor+)2(seb2–)·3H2O del bulk non compare fra le strutture (c'e' solo ·4CH3OH); «crystallization of enro» elencata fra gli endotermi; (nor+)(sub–)·3H2O fonde a 204.1 °C nella corsa diretta e a 211.9 °C dopo il trattamento a 140 °C. Non sono eventi: la gelificazione (26 delle 216 combinazioni sale/solvente danno gel; Tgel di 10% wt fra 40 e 60 °C; gel termoreversibili; enro/sub/H2O e nor/az/glicole propilenico invariati per 2 settimane con Tgel in calo di <3 °C, enro/sub e cip/sub in glicole propilenico con calo di 9 °C), perche' il gel non e' una forma cristallina; la reologia; il SEM (aghi di >10 µm); il confronto con i pattern simulati dei xerogel. Gli intervalli di pKa degli acidi (3.7–4.7) non sono attribuiti ai singoli acidi. Le miscele macinate esistono per 27 campioni (216/8), non per 28: non e' detto quale manchi, quindi sono estratti solo i macinati con esito descritto.
